items.title: Willie Hightower Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: And he used me and he used my clarinet player as Fred Palm and he used John Lindsay, my trombone player.

ctx.x: And he used me and he used my clarinet player as Fred Palm and he used John Lindsay, my trombone player. Oh yeah. He's in y'all. He's in old now jazz. He played bass too. That's what you knew him is because in New Orleans he played bass when he's... Yeah. Thank you.
